verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted deployment of Statsig's core product. Warehouse Native runs analysis in your own warehouse, and the SDKs evaluate gates locally after initialization. Both are adjacent features that still rely on the Statsig-hosted console and platform, so neither counts as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
